text:
maria: Quick debrief from today's probe: we prototyped a cheap-coarse -> full fallback gate for onboarding a 13B quant candidate. Results mixed: good latency wins but some QA metric regressions.

kai: short version of the gating logic? and exact run command?

maria: gate logic: run tiny-quant-coarse (4-bit) to propose tokens. If the token-level Shannon entropy <= 0.55 accept, else run full 13B. Implemented as a streaming accept check. Command: ```./rundec --proposal-model tiny-q4 --target-model llama3-13b --accept-ent 0.55 --stream-accept --run=qc_9302_trial1```

james: numbers please

maria: baseline vs gate (small NaturalQA subset): median token latency -24%, p95 -14%, throughput +33%. Estimated per-token compute cost -20%. BUT QA exact-match dropped by 3.8 pts on the heldout set. We logged ~0.9% "premature-accepts" where the coarse model confidently picked the wrong token and the full model would have chosen a different (correct) continuation.

laura: do we have raw logits or calibration curves? quantization often sharpens logits -> artificially low entropy.

maria: yes uploaded per-token logits and accept decisions to s3://redwood-experiments/quant-gates/qc_9302/ . Quick plot shows coarse model entropy distribution shifted left ~0.2 nats compared to float baseline.

kai: options: (A) temperature scaling on coarse logits (apply tau>1 to soften), (B) use percentile-based threshold (per-prompt adapt), (C) cheap ensemble of two distinct tiny q4 variants and average logits, (D) accept-only-when-top2-gap small.

james: also consider a verifier micro-rerank that scores the accepted token (or short span) with a distilled verifier model. Adds cost but might reduce error rate with small overhead.

maria: tried a small verifier (distil-qa) in a micro-run: verifier rescoring of the accepted answer recovered ~2.6 EM on our sample set at ~+4% compute and p95 latency +6%. Not perfect but promising.

ops-bot: canary jobs launched: qc_9302_trial1 (10 replicas) on dedicated-gpu-pool-2 :rocket:

laura: experimental plan to isolate variables: 1) entropy-threshold sweep 0.35->0.75 step 0.05; 2) apply temp scaling tau in [0.8,1.0,1.2,1.5]; 3) try ensemble mean logits (two q4 variants); 4) add top2-gap rule; 5) run with KV-cache on and off. Each cell run with 3 RNG seeds.

kai: add adversarial QA prompts and time-series traces for early token accepts. Also include per-example flags: accept_reason (entropy / ensemble / gap), accepted_token, full_model_token, accept_timestamp.

maria: will generate run IDs: qc_9302-A (baseline gate 0.55), qc_9302-B (threshold sweep), qc_9302-C (temp scaling), qc_9302-D (ensemble), qc_9302-E (verifier). Collected metadata includes model git sha, quant config, seed. Logs -> s3://redwood-experiments/quant-gates/qc_9302/{run-id}/.

james: make sure to capture token alignment when comparing accepts vs full-model so we don't misattribute shifted tokens as errors. Use greedy-decoded alignment script: scripts/align_tokens.py --coarse --full --out csv.

laura: on the theory side: we should check whether quant noise introduces mode collapse in next-token distribution; if so, mitigations include logits jittering, temp scaling, or small dropout ensemble.

maria: FYI I also ran a tiny sweep of percentile-threshold (adaptive per-prompt): accept if entropy <= median_entropy(prompt_prefix)+k where k in [-0.1,0.1]. This improved robustness on one subset but was noisy overall. Will include full sweep results in morning.

kai: please attach a short CSV of per-example accept decisions and a small set of human-inspected failure traces (5-10). Ops will want cost projections if we move to a rerank step in Hosted API.

maria: done. Uploads + run manifests in s3. Next sync tomorrow AM with plots: latency vs EM vs accept-rate. :thumbsup:
